graph.notes: Coordinates are integer pixel offsets in the legacy floor-plan SVG coordinate space (origin top-left, y increases downward). They are not latitude/longitude.

assets.modification: Removed the 4 red QR-marker glyphs (QR1-QR4) baked into the upstream artwork. QR anchor points are out of scope for this version — see modification_note below. Geometry, viewBox and all room/structure paths are untouched.

transform_evidence.method: Matched every <rect> by (width,height) between the superseded asset and this one, then took the modal (dx,dy) offset.
transform_evidence.known_divergence: 29 rects do not match at this offset; they cluster at x < 200 (left wing), which was redrawn in this asset. Pins in that region need 100% visual verification.
transform_evidence.selected_because: Roughly 44% more path geometry (105 vs 90 paths), 28 vs 18 room-number glyph outlines, a uniform #EFEEEE structural palette instead of a mixed #E5E5E5/#D9D9D9/#CACACA one, and a decorative outer frame.

assets.modification: Removed the 4 red QR-marker glyphs (QR5-QR8) baked into the upstream artwork. QR anchor points are out of scope for this version — see modification_note below. Geometry, viewBox and all room/structure paths are untouched.

transform_evidence.method: Matched every <rect> by (width,height) between the superseded asset and this one, then took the modal (dx,dy) offset.
transform_evidence.known_divergence: 4 rects do not match at this offset; the artwork is otherwise identical to the superseded asset.
transform_evidence.selected_because: A tight crop that removes roughly 238px of empty vertical space, and an opaque white background rect — the superseded asset has a transparent background and renders poorly on dark surfaces.

modification_note: Both floor assets deviate from the upstream blob: the 4 red circular QR-marker glyphs baked into each floor's artwork (QR1-4 on floor 1, QR5-8 on floor 2) were removed. QR anchor points are out of scope for this dataset version (the corresponding LC3_QR1..QR8 nodes are already excluded from the seed with reason qr_anchor_not_a_room) and showing markers the app has no matching feature for was judged misleading. sha256 is of the edited file; upstream_sha256 on each asset is kept for provenance and is what `git cat-file -p <commit>:<source_path> | sha256sum` still produces. No structural/room geometry, viewBox, or coordinate space was touched by this edit.
integrity_rules: Copy assets byte-for-byte. Do not run SVGO, reformat, or edit the viewBox - any geometry change invalidates coordinate_transform.
coordinate_transform is the single source of truth for remapping legacy graph coordinates onto these assets. Tools must read it from this manifest rather than hardcoding the numbers.

Hashes are of the upstream COMMITTED BLOB (LF line endings), obtained with `git cat-file -p <commit>:<source_path>` - not of a working-tree checkout. A Windows checkout with core.autocrlf=true yields CRLF and a different hash. .gitattributes pins these paths to eol=lf so every platform's working tree matches these hashes.
